quote: Capital expenditure totalled US$553.8 million in the first half of 2026, including US$272.4 million at Las Bambas, US$138.6 million at Khoemacau (of which US$91.1 million related to the expansion project) and US$45.8 million at Kinsevere.
note: Opened MMG HKEX interim results 11 Aug 2026 (Las Bambas H1 CapEx USD 272.4m).
